title: Enterprise Support: Approved review physical evidence for source-line debit assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Approved review physical evidence for source-line debit assessment.

## Decision basis

For source-line debit assessment: Read the approved incorrect billing review quantity for the exact original source charge and service period; pending or rejected reviews contribute zero.

## Hypothetical case

For source-line debit assessment: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.
